summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K covering routine second-quarter and half-year 2026 results, including approval of the first tranche of the 2026 dividend (0.27 per share, payable 23 September 2026, record date 22 September 2026; ADR holders receive 0.54 per ADR). The filing also reports raised production guidance and increased buyback to 3.4 billion, plus operational updates (Searah JV with Petronas, FID on Baleine Phase 3, etc.). No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or activist campaign is present; this is a routine earnings and dividend announcement.
